newsitem.title: SPAIN: CYCLING-SPANISH RIDER, RACE OFFICIAL HURT IN COLLISION.
newsitem.headline: CYCLING-SPANISH RIDER, RACE OFFICIAL HURT IN COLLISION.

text.p: A Spanish rider and a race official were both in serious condition after a collision in the Criterium de Fuenlabrada on Saturday.
Jose Antonio Espinosa, of the MX Onda team, was taken to hospital in Madrid and was in a coma after sustaining severe head injuries in the accident.
Race official Fernando Casillas was also in hospital suffering from trauma and facial bone fractures.
